entries.german: [Überlassung eines Hofs zu Bolzhausen an] Hermann Lesch, Lkt Fr und Kt Mgh, [und das DOH Mgh durch Konrad Lesch von Uissigheim, Ritter, und seine Frau Alheid von Bachenstein], 1299 [Juni 21].
entries.english: [transfer of an estate at Bolzhausen to] Hermann Lesch, regional commander of Franconia and commander at Mergentheim, [and the Mergentheim house by Konrad Lesch von Uissigheim, Ritter, and his wife Alheid von Bachenstein], 1299 [June 21].
